description.text: Program Description Economicsis a theoretical and applied undergraduate major established to meet the needs of market economy development. This specialized raise the quite solid foundation of economic theory, familiar with the modern economic theory, more skillfully mastering modern economic analysis method, with wider knowledge, has the ability to expand to the economics field penetration in comprehensive economic management, policy research departments, financial institutions and enterprises engaged in economic analysis, forecast, planning and economic management of senior specialized talents. Duration 4 years

duration.text: The Economics at Shanghai University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.(at least 1 A4 page)
